user.title: Summon your Spooky Light
user.description: Pick your Spooky light — paired through Matter, ZHA or Zigbee2MQTT (it reports itself as SpookyLab NanoC6 / NanoH2). Matter lights are mapped automatically; Zigbee lights are mapped on the next step. Leave empty to map Zigbee entities by hand.

entities.title: Which entity does what?
entities.description: {found} entities were recognised automatically — check them, fill any gaps, and press Submit. Only the light and the effect control are required.

matter.title: Matter light found
matter.description: Found the colour light, {switches} of {effects} effect switches and {extras} of {extras_total} extra controls by their Matter endpoint numbers. Press Submit to haunt it. The raw effect switches and helper dimmers will be hidden from the device page — Spooky Lights shows them as an effect list, speed, output and spotlight controls instead.

abort.already_configured: This NanoC6 is already haunted by Spooky Lights.
abort.not_spooky_matter: This Matter device doesn't look like a Spooky light (no colour light on endpoint 1 or no effect switches on endpoints 2–12). Is it running the Spooky Lights Matter firmware?

rescan.title: Re-scan Matter endpoints
rescan.description: Map the light's entities again from its Matter endpoints (useful after re-commissioning it).
